A gallery of water photographs taken in various natural settings, showcasing different forms and behaviors of water in nature.

A Raspberry in the Dew
A dew drop beneath a raspberry leaf reflects the fruit above, creating a miniature inverted world.
Camera: Canon EOS 5D Mk IV
Lens: EF100mm f/2.8L Macro IS USM
Settings: ISO 800 • Aperture f/16.0 • Shutter 1/60 s
E22A6236 • Size: 6720x4480

Rain Held Close
After a storm, rain is held in clear droplets on a fallen oak leaf, capturing the essence of the recent weather.
Camera: Canon EOS 5D Mk IV
Lens: EF100mm f/2.8L Macro IS USM
Settings: ISO 400 • Aperture f/11.0 • Shutter 1/125 s
E21A0028 • Size: 6720x4480
